judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a brief spec stub in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationListFrame.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any production code at all (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc. are all untouched). As a result, the new acceptance test will not even compile (`startEngineWith` does not accept `history`) and all test cases fail. Almost none of the ticket's implementation or documentation requirements were delivered.
